notes: Stories already existed; refined dependencies to enforce execution order and remove ambiguity.

change_log.note: Core logic depends on corrected schema/contracts
API routing depends on stable core logic
Tests depend on full implementation stack
Integration depends on logic and routing fixes

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation Fixes
stories.description: Audit and correct Pydantic models and data contracts for two-tier HIPAA consent to ensure Tier 1 vs Tier 2 fields, required flags, and de-identification markers are consistently enforced.

stories.title: Core Consent Logic Edge Case Fixes
stories.description: Fix defects in ConsentService covering tier escalation, duplicate consent handling, partial consent states, and failure paths in de-identification and summarization workflow.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Routing Corrections
stories.description: Ensure consent flows are correctly triggered and enforced via tool_router and API layer, including proper gating before lead capture and unknown question handling.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Add and fix unit and integration tests for two-tier consent, including Tier 1 only, Tier 2 escalation, refusal paths, and de-identification validation.

stories.title: Lead Capture and Unknown Question Integration Fixes
stories.description: Validate and fix integration between ConsentService, LeadService, and UnknownQuestionService to ensure consent state is consistently respected across all entry points.
